people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

translations.web: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one other.
translations.bsb: So Lot chose the whole plain of the Jordan for himself and set out toward the east. And Abram and Lot parted company.
translations.kjv: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
translations.asv: So Lot chose him all the Plain of the Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
